snippet.title: Definitely Not Fried Chicken | Company Induction
snippet.description:
Welcome to your first day at Definitely Not Fried Chicken! We have prepared a company induction for you to bring you up to speed on everything you'll need to know to kickstart your new business empire.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036240/Definitely_Not_Fried_Chicken/

Definitely Not Fried Chicken is a business management sim with a Twist! Grow your drugs trade through legitimate fronts by managing both sides of the business. Acquire new "businesses", meet new clientele, develop more potent narcotics, make lots of money and leave a city in ruin!

Key features
Start your drugs empire from the ground up, distributing marijuana, cocaine, methamphetamine and other goods
Balance the demanding tasks of managing both your illegal drugs trade and your “legit” businesses.
Build and customise your drugs compound and business fronts.
Upgrade your facilities and staff equipment for a better product and a bigger profit
Design your empire, from fried chicken shops to laundromats to nightclubs
Manage your workforce, hire & fire, accommodate for their wants and needs to do great work.

Live your Breaking Bad fantasy!
